notes: BC-0110 heuristic ranking policy (planning/06 section 9, PRD 7.4). Loaded by com.beaconclimb.api.ranking.PolicyLoader; the JCS form of this file is ranking_policies.serialized_config.
code_digest is NOT stored here: PolicyLoader computes sha256 over the compiled classes of the ranking package at load time and PolicyRegistry writes it to ranking_policies.code_digest.
band_targets and goal_offsets are planning placeholders mapping a self-assessed band and a session goal to a target grade_numeric; they claim nothing about physical difficulty or ability.
skill_gap keeps its PRD weight but multiplies a constant 0 in v1 (no skill-gap signal yet).
preferred_tags use the tag vocabulary of ml/datasets/synthetic/generate.py (crimpy, slopers, dynamic, technical, powerful, balancy).
score = challenge*challenge_fit + skill_gap*0 + novelty*novelty + preference*preference_match + confidence*confidence_bonus, summed strictly left to right (Scoring.score).
